reference_sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN t.revenue_eur >= 1000 THEN t.revenue_eur ELSE 0 END) / SUM(t.revenue_eur), 4) AS share_big_customers
FROM (
  -- one row per registered customer
  SELECT o.customer_id, SUM(s.net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur
  FROM sales s
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = s.order_id
  WHERE o.customer_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY o.customer_id
) AS t
alternatives:
WITH customer_revenue AS (
  -- one row per registered customer
  SELECT o.customer_id, SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur) AS revenue_eur
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.customer_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY o.customer_id
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN revenue_eur >= 1000 THEN revenue_eur ELSE 0 END) / SUM(revenue_eur), 4) AS share_big_customers
FROM customer_revenue

SELECT ROUND(SUM(t.revenue_eur) FILTER (WHERE t.revenue_eur >= 1000) / SUM(t.revenue_eur), 4) AS share_big_customers
FROM (

  FROM sales s

  WHERE o.customer_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY o.customer_id
) AS t

solver.query:
WITH cust AS (SELECT o.customer_id, SUM(s.net_revenue_eur) AS total FROM sales s JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = s.order_id WHERE o.customer_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.customer_id)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN total >= 1000 THEN total ELSE 0 END) / SUM(total), 4) AS share_big_customers FROM cust
